mapper.select: SELECT id, pet_id AS petId, affected_area AS affectedArea, symptoms_json AS symptomsJson, image_url AS imageUrl, description, risk_level AS riskLevel, vision_result_json AS diseasesJson, rag_report AS reportContent, created_at AS createdAt FROM diagnosis_records WHERE pet_id = #{petId} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, pet_id AS petId, affected_area AS affectedArea, symptoms_json AS symptomsJson, image_url AS imageUrl, description, risk_level AS riskLevel, vision_result_json AS diseasesJson, rag_report AS reportContent, created_at AS createdAt FROM diagnosis_records WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diagnosis_records (user_id, pet_id, affected_area, symptoms_json, image_url, description, risk_level, risk_label, diseases_json, report_content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{petId}, #{affectedArea}, #{symptomsJson}, #{imageUrl}, #{description}, #{riskLevel}, #{riskLabel}, #{diseasesJson}, #{reportContent})
